The end bound must be exclusive per the docstring and README ('valid from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive)'), i.e. `promo["start"] <= today < promo["end"]`. payload.rationale: The root cause is an off-by-one on the promo window's end bound: promo_pct() uses the closed interval `promo["start"] <= today <= promo["end"]`, so a promo is still honored on its end date. Both the docstring (pyshop/pricing.py:39) and the README state the end is exclusive, and the failing test asserts promo_pct("SPRING10", date(2026, 6, 1)) == 0 while Mar 1 and May 31 still return 10. Changing the second `<=` to `<` makes the end bound exclusive, so SPRING10 is invalid exactly on 2026-06-01, matching the documented semantics and the passing assertions. This is the smallest change that fixes the root cause; no other logic or data is affected.
